agentReporter.description: The options for the agent reporter
agentReporter.title: AgentReporterOptions

fileName.description: The relative filename for the agent report.

partial.description: Write survivors, timeouts and other actionable mutant results to a partial report (named after `fileName`, with `.partial.jsonl` before its extension) as soon as each one is known, so a coding agent can act on them before the run finishes. Set to `false` to disable.
